Economy · India

E20 Fuel Rollout Sparks Debate on Vehicle Safety and Fuel Prices

India has rolled out its E20 fuel program, which blends 20% ethanol with petrol. While the government and industry experts assert the fuel's safety for all vehicles, citing extensive testing, some political figures and consumer groups have raised concerns about potential damage to older vehicles and reduced mileage. Separately, discussions continue regarding potential cuts to petrol and diesel prices, with the government indicating this may occur only after sustained lower crude oil prices benefit oil marketers.
